name: cmg-educational-animation
description: Banco de pruebas de vídeos educativos de Codemageddon (fuera del juego).

scripts.remotion: npm run sync-assets -w compositions/remotion && npm run studio -w compositions/remotion
scripts.render:remotion: npm run sync-assets -w compositions/remotion && npm run render -w compositions/remotion && node tools/render-manifest.mjs renders/remotion/await-pilot.mp4 AwaitPilot
scripts.render:remotion:en: npm run sync-assets -w compositions/remotion && npm run render:en -w compositions/remotion && node tools/render-manifest.mjs renders/remotion/await-pilot-en.mp4 AwaitPilotEn
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w concepts/motion-canvas && npm run typecheck -w compositions/remotion
